panels.description: Alex jumps back and knocks over a stool while Bi11bot dusts his shoulders. Leave upper-left clear.
Bi11bot’s warm amber eyes narrow to focus and the right-eye ring clicks. Keep his face open and non-menacing.
Over Bi11bot’s shoulder, Alex stands with arms crossed. Leave upper corners clear.
Bi11bot looks toward Alex’s wrist as Alex pulls the sleeve over the watch. Leave upper-left clear.
Alex turns the watch in his palm, showing the engraved equation. Bi11bot’s mustard hand hovers above it. Leave lettering zones clear.
A projector unfolds from Bi11bot’s shoulder and soft-blue light falls across Alex. Leave upper-left clear.

items.speaker: BI11BOT
items.text: You're taller than your father predicted.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: Everyone in Keel claims they knew my father.

items.speaker: BI11BOT
items.text: Most of them knew his reputation. I knew his mistakes.

items.speaker: BI11BOT
items.text: Your father bet me you'd leave it in the dust. I said you wouldn't.

items.speaker: BI11BOT
items.text: Almost isn't doing it. Now, shall we say hello to your father?
